title: [narrowed from route-edit-f91c8968] investigate and decompose gap route-edit-efc1285c: A WIRED PROVIDER WITH NO KEY IS S
description:
[narrowed from route-edit-f91c8968] investigate and decompose gap route-edit-efc1285c: A WIRED PROVIDER WITH NO KEY IS SILENT CAPACITY LOSS, AND NOTHING IN THE SUBSTRATE REPORTS IT. llm-resolver-vessel/src/index.ts builds its OpenAI-wire provider clients once at module load: `const key = cleanEnv(process.env[p.apiKeyEnv]) ?? p.defaultKey; if (!key) continue;`. A provider whose key env is empty is therefore skipped entirely -- it never enters modelClientMap, never becomes a routable

WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):
- semantic_reject: The patch modifies the logging message but does not change the behavior of skipping a provider with an empty key, thus it does not address the gap.
- typecheck_dangling_reference: src/index.ts(344,10): error TS2448: Block-scoped variable 'daemon' used before its declaration.
src/index.ts(344,10): error TS2454: Variable 'daemon' is used before being assigned.
src/index.ts(344,28

Do not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above.
